title: Quiet Authority — Scholarly Serif Editorial
description: A restrained, serif-led template modeled on literary reviews and Tufte handouts — built for ML paper seminars where equations, block quotes, and footnoted citations share the page in quiet authority.

typography.heading: high-contrast transitional serif, regular weight, generous letter-spacing
typography.body: classical oldstyle serif, book weight, optimized for sustained reading at text sizes

layoutNotes: Single-column body occupies a centered 58% content zone, flanked by a wide outer margin (~24% of slide width) reserved for marginalia, figure callouts, and equation labels. A hairline rule in the oxblood accent color separates the slide header from the body column; no other decorative elements appear. Typographic hierarchy is established through size scale and weight alone — no fills, shadows, or gradients. A fine-ruled footer zone at 8% slide height carries the superscript citation reference list at reduced size.
promptCore: Design a slide that carries the quiet authority of a Tufte handout or literary review — a single centered prose column flanked by wide margins held in reserve for marginalia, equation labels, and figure callouts. Hierarchy emerges from scale alone; no fills, shadows, or gradients disturb the scholarly calm. A single hairline rule in the accent tone divides the header from the body — beyond that, restraint is the only ornament. This is a seminar handout, not a deck.
goodFor: ML paper seminars with inline KaTeX equations
3-plus line block quotes with source attribution
Dense prose slides with superscript citations and footer reference lists
Marginalia annotations alongside narrow figure callouts
avoidFor: Presentations requiring vibrant multi-color data dashboards
author: harness
